name: Net Worth Ledger
shortDescription: A monthly net worth chart that grows as your agent adds a line.
description: One chart of everything you own and owe, one point a month. Assets stack above the zero line, debts mirror them below, and net worth runs as a bold line across both, with a flag where it first crosses each milestone. Drag the scrubber to any month: the headline rolls to that month's net worth and a donut redraws its accounts. A table lists every month with its changes. Each month you tell your agent the balances in one sentence, it adds a line to your ledger file and runs again, and the chart grows by one point. Light and dark themes, phone and desktop, and nothing leaves your machine.
